annotations.title: Upcoming Dutch tax and admin deadlines for a situation

description: The coming deadlines for someone in the Netherlands, from today: the income tax return, provisional assessments, the 30% ruling application window and its end, allowances (toeslagen) changes, health insurance switching, Box 3, pension (jaarruimte) and leaving the country.

employee.description: Works as an employee. Default true.

homeowner.description: Owns the home they live in. Default false.

job_start_date.description: Start date of the Dutch job, YYYY-MM-DD (for the 30% ruling window). Optional.

leaving_date.description: Date of leaving the Netherlands, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

little_employer_pension.description: No or a small employer pension. Default false.

provisional_assessment.description: Gets or pays a provisional assessment (voorlopige aanslag). Default false.

ruling_start_date.description: Start date of a granted ruling, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

savings_above_allowance.description: Savings and investments above the Box 3 tax-free allowance. Default false.

name: dutch_tax_deadlines
